annotations.title: Create a discount or access code

description: Create a promo code (type=coded), a public discount (type=public, single event) or an access code that unlocks hidden tickets (type=access). Scope: event_id (+ticket_class_ids) for one event, ticket_group_id for a group, neither for all the organization's events. Eventbrite: POST /organizations/{organization_id}/discounts/.

amount_off.description: Fixed amount off in the event currency, e.g. "10" or "7.50". Not together with percent_off.

code.description: The code (or the public discount's name). No spaces for coded/access.

end_date.description: Usable until, naive local time in the event's timezone, e.g. 2026-11-01T09:00:00.

event_id.description: Limit to one event. Omit (with ticket_group_id also omitted) for an organization-wide discount.

organization_id.description: Organization ID (from eventbrite_list_organizations). This is NOT the organizer id in an organizer profile URL.

percent_off.description: Percentage off, 1.00–100.00, e.g. "20". Not together with amount_off.

quantity_available.description: How many times it can be used; 0 = unlimited.

start_date.description: Usable from, naive local time in the event's timezone, e.g. 2026-11-01T09:00:00.

ticket_class_ids.description: Limit to these ticket classes of event_id.

type.description: coded = promo code, public = shown on the listing, access = unlocks hidden tickets.

name: eventbrite_create_discount
title: Create a discount or access code
